name.zh: 新不伦瑞克省横加公路 2 号

tagline.en: Where the country's Highway 1 is not the Trans-Canada
tagline.zh: 在这里，本省的 1 号公路并不是横加公路

start.en: The Quebec boundary near Edmundston, where Autoroute 85 becomes Route 2
start.zh: 埃德蒙兹顿附近的魁北克省界，85 号高速公路在此变为 2 号公路

end.en: The Nova Scotia boundary at Aulac, opposite Amherst, where the designation continues on Highway 104
end.zh: 奥拉克的新斯科舍省界，对岸即阿默斯特，指定路线在此转由 104 号公路承接

en: New Brunswick is the clearest illustration of what it means for Canada to have no national route-numbering scheme. The Trans-Canada Highway is Highway 1 in British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan and Manitoba, and Highway 1 again in Prince Edward Island and Newfoundland — but in New Brunswick it is Route 2, and the province's own Route 1 is a different road entirely, running along the Bay of Fundy from St. Stephen to Saint John and on to Moncton.

The designation enters from Quebec as the continuation of Autoroute 85, runs down the Saint John River valley past Edmundston and Fredericton, turns east at Moncton, and leaves for Nova Scotia at Aulac. A second designated route, Route 16, branches off to the Confederation Bridge and Prince Edward Island.
The province signed on 27 May 1950, a month after the first group.
zh: 新不伦瑞克最清楚地说明了「加拿大没有全国统一编号体系」意味着什么。横加公路在不列颠哥伦比亚、艾伯塔、萨斯喀彻温与马尼托巴是 1 号公路，在爱德华王子岛与纽芬兰也是 1 号公路——但在新不伦瑞克它是 2 号公路，而本省自己的 1 号公路完全是另一条路，沿芬迪湾自圣斯蒂芬经圣约翰通往蒙克顿。
指定路线自魁北克进入，接续 85 号高速公路，沿圣约翰河谷经埃德蒙兹顿与弗雷德里克顿南下，在蒙克顿折向东，自奥拉克进入新斯科舍。另一条指定路线 16 号公路由此分出，通往联邦大桥与爱德华王子岛。
该省于 1950 年 5 月 27 日签约，比第一批省份晚了一个月。

en: The 1949 Act let each province designate its own route, subject only to agreeing terminal points with its neighbours and to choosing the shortest practical east-west line. Numbering was never part of the bargain, and nothing in the Act or in any later federal instrument obliges a province to number its share consistently with anyone else's.

The consequence is visible at every provincial boundary on the corridor. Manitoba's PTH 1 becomes Ontario's Highway 17; Ontario's 417 becomes Quebec's Autoroute 40; Quebec's Autoroute 85 becomes New Brunswick's Route 2; Route 2 becomes Nova Scotia's Highway 104. Twenty-two distinct route numbers carry the designation across the ten provinces.

The one thing that is consistent is the shield. The green-and-white Trans-Canada marker is posted the length of the corridor, but its use rests on a national guideline with, in the words of the manual's own publisher, no legislative authority.
zh: 1949 年法案允许各省自行指定本省路线，唯一的约束是须与邻省议定交界点，并选择最短的可行东西向线路。编号从来不在这笔交易之内；法案本身以及此后任何联邦文件，都未要求某省的编号须与他省一致。
后果在这条走廊的每一处省界上都看得见。马尼托巴的 PTH 1 变为安大略的 17 号；安大略的 417 号变为魁北克的 40 号高速；魁北克的 85 号高速变为新不伦瑞克的 2 号；2 号又变为新斯科舍的 104 号。十省之间，共有二十二个不同的编号承载着这条指定路线。
唯一始终一致的是盾牌标志。绿白相间的横加公路标志沿走廊全线设置，但其使用依据只是一份全国性指南——用该手册出版方自己的话说，它「不具备立法权威」。

value.en: 390 miles (628 km) of the main route
value.zh: 主线 390 英里（628 公里）

figures.source: Canada Year Book 1967, p. 805, Dominion Bureau of Statistics

value.en: 27 May 1950, a month after the first six provinces
value.zh: 1950 年 5 月 27 日，比最早签署的六省晚一个月

figures.source: Canada Year Book 1951, p. 633, Dominion Bureau of Statistics

value.en: Two in New Brunswick — Route 2 for the main line and Route 16 for the Confederation Bridge spur. Twenty-two across the ten provinces.
value.zh: 新不伦瑞克境内有两条：主线为 2 号，联邦大桥支线为 16 号。十省合计二十二个编号。

figures.source: Statistics Canada, National Road Network, Trans-Canada Highway layer, queried September 2026

timeline.en: New Brunswick signs its Trans-Canada Highway agreement on 27 May.
timeline.zh: 5 月 27 日，新不伦瑞克签署横加公路协议。

timeline.en: The Confederation Bridge opens, putting Route 16 and the Prince Edward Island spur on a road connection.
timeline.zh: 联邦大桥通车，16 号公路与爱德华王子岛支线由此有了陆路连接。
